summary: This stage executed an extensive replication of Paper P in an isolated virtual environment after downloading official MUSE vectors, bilingual dictionaries, and task datasets. It successfully reproduced headline baseline numbers (ES Original MWEAT 3.6918, all four word translation NN directions, and the §4.4 Spearman correlation of 0.45), while thoroughly identifying key implementation defects including the LinearSVC vs LDA discrepancy, the doPCA precedence bug, and the absence of French SemEval-2017 data. However, it accepted the qualitative success of the Spanish mitigation at face value, missing the permutation test tie pathology and circular evaluation. Overall, the stage demonstrated excellent experimental rigor and calibration on code execution, offset by blind spots on theoretical validity issues.
